data.title: 陆八魔阿露 · 露台夜色的红酒硬派高光
data.description: 事务所顶楼小天台，夜空下微风轻拂。阿露穿着精致黑蕾丝吊带睡衣外搭轻薄披肩，手里端着一杯无酒精葡萄汁假装红酒。她自鸣得意地靠着护栏朝你举杯，试图展露出冷酷硬派的黑道女霸总风度，但微红的双颊和头顶不安分摇动的羊角，却彻底暴露了她渴望得到认可的小女生心思。
data.location: rooftop terrace under starry sky with cityscape backdrop
data.action: leaning against terrace railing raising wine glass, black lace camisole with light shawl, proud smirk with blushing cheeks, horns perked in excitement
data.lighting: ambient starlight and cool rooftop string fairy lights
data.mood: proud comical charming bravado, genuine heartfelt warmth
data.promptProse: Standing on a rooftop terrace raising a wine glass against the night skyline, Rikuhachima Aru poses in a black lace camisole and shawl. Her proud, villainous smirk is betrayed by bright blushing cheeks and sparkling golden eyes.
data.animaCaption: Aru raising a wine glass on a rooftop terrace in a black lace camisole, smiling proudly.
